Rama, that it seemed to them that but an hour had passed. 
Rama too spent the time happily in the company of the monkeys, 
who were able to change their form at will, and the extremely 
powerful titans and bears of great energy. 
In this way the second month of autumn passed and the 
monkeys and titans savoured delights of every kind in that city 
belonging to the Ikshvakus that was full of allurements and, 
during the time they were thus entertained, by the grace of 
Ramo's affectionate regard, the hours flew by happily for them.

brief.summary_1line: Rama bids farewell to Sugriva, Vibhishana, and the monkey and bear allies, praising their loyalty and honoring Hanuman with a pearl necklace.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama rises from his throne and embraces Hanuman before placing a radiant pearl necklace with a shining emerald around his neck.
The gathered monkeys, bears, and rakshasas bow at Rama’s feet in the royal court before departing.
Hanuman stands with the pearl garland glowing on his chest, shining like Mount Sumeru under the moon.
